name: Ewer with Decoration of Leafed Fruiting Branches
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；9th century；Changsha ware: light gray stoneware with three molded appliqué decorative elements, the ewer coated with olive-toned celadon glaze over a thin coat of white slip, the appliqué elements further splashed with caramel glaze. From the kilns at Tongguan, Changsha, Hunan province.
